importantNotes: Negative marking: 25% or 1/4th of the total marks given for the question will be deducted for each wrong answer.
If more than one answer is given or if the candidate has not filled the complete circle on the OMR sheet, it will be treated as a wrong answer and 25% or 1/4th marks will be deducted.
If the total final marks come with decimals, they will remain in decimals and further action will be taken based on those decimal marks.
If a question is left unattempted, no negative marking will apply.
Final merit list will be based on the combined marks of the objective test and interview.
